facts.text: Bellewood was formally incorporated by the Kentucky state assembly in 1950, establishing its status as an independent municipality.
Bellewood is a home rule-class city located within Jefferson County, Kentucky, giving it local governance autonomy.
Bellewood lies in northern Jefferson County, just 6 miles east of downtown Louisville.
Bellewood is bordered by Brownsboro Village to the northwest, Druid Hills to the north, a portion of Louisville to the northeast, and Matthews on east, south, and west.
The city is composed of about 130 homes from neighborhoods such as Elmwood, Brookfield, Leland, Ormond, Ridgeway, part of Napanee, and St.
Residents often see speed humps on all cut‑through streets, and the city encourages drivers to obey posted limits and watch for children playing.
